CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS doc_sequences (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  document_number VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sequence_counter INT NOT NULL,
  document_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  company VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  division VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  month_roman VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
  month_numeric INT NOT NULL,
  year INT NOT NULL,
  revision_number INT DEFAULT 0,
  document_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  document_description TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'draft',
  created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  approved_by VARCHAR(36),
  approved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  updated_by VARCHAR(36),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  change_history JSON
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS doc_sequence_counters (
  id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
  document_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  company VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  division VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  year INT NOT NULL,
  current_value INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_doc_sequences_company_division ON doc_sequences(company, division);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_doc_sequences_document_type ON doc_sequences(document_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_doc_sequences_created_at ON doc_sequences(created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_doc_seq_counters_type ON doc_sequence_counters(document_type, company, division, year);
